title: callianthemum sajanense

It is primarily used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of C. sajanense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy of C. sajanense, but it is believed to have potential in treating a range of health conditions, from fever and infections to cardiovascular and respiratory diseases.
